concept.cross_view_consistency_note: CH106-like original silhouette uses one central basal wedge and unequal forked flat lobes. Fossil carbonized brown relief has finite thickness, not living green foliage. Original supporting shale slab, irregular nonrepeating edge. Petiole and lobe breadths accentuated gently for readability; no invented diagnostic venation or leaf-mining damage. Geometry meters are nominal teaching-prop scale, not a claim of scanned dimensions. Concept inspected: concept basal lobe blades are broader and more decorative than CH106; correct geometry to narrower flat strips and deeper uneven divisions, avoid transferring concept broad fan into fossil claim. Preserve seven-ish terminal tips, not exact division count.
